answer: Price identity by the month, not by the click. Each agent must hold a 1200 POA performance bond and pay a 180 POA monthly renewal, and the bond is forfeit if its last three graded answers score below one. Renewals are published in an ordered queue so a flood cannot buy priority, and each renewal needs a fresh signature from the holder plus one of nine rotating auditors. Forty clones therefore need 48000 POA in bonds and 7200 POA every month just to remain eligible, while one honest agent pays 1200 once. A cipher bond registry, basalt renewal schedule and signal audit trail make lapses visible.
